inputs.NO_SESSION: You are not signed in. Scan your badge again.

inputs.NOT_AUTHORIZED: This action needs a supervisor who is signed in to Microsoft with their own account.
inputs.SUPERVISOR_REJECTED: A supervisor rejected this request. Nothing was changed.
inputs.STOCK_NOT_FOUND: That item/location does not exist. Nothing was changed.
inputs.STOCK_INACTIVE: That item/location is inactive. Nothing was changed.
inputs.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more. Nothing was changed.
inputs.INVALID_COUNT: Counted quantity must be a whole number of 0 or more. Nothing was changed.
inputs.NO_BALANCE: This item/location has no verified quantity yet. A supervisor must count it first (Audit). Nothing was changed.
inputs.BALANCE_UNVERIFIED: This quantity has not been verified by a count yet. Nothing was changed.
inputs.MISSING_EXPECTED_VERSION: The count did not record the stock version it started from. Recount. Nothing was changed.
inputs.OPENING_NOT_ALLOWED: An opening balance can only be set once, on a record with no balance. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REVERSAL_TARGET_MISSING: The movement to reverse was not found. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REVERSAL_NOT_POSTED: Only posted ISSUE or RECEIPT movements can be reversed. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REVERSAL_WRONG_STOCK: That movement belongs to a different item/location. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REVERSAL_ALREADY: That movement has already been reversed. Nothing was changed.
inputs.REVERSAL_NEGATIVE: Reversing would make the quantity negative. Use an ADJUSTMENT instead. Nothing was changed.
inputs.DRIFT_DETECTED: The stored quantity does not match its history. A supervisor has been alerted. Nothing was changed.
inputs.STOCK_CHANGED_OUTSIDE_PROTOCOL: The stored quantity was changed outside the normal process while this was being posted. A supervisor has been alerted. Nothing was changed by this request.
inputs.PAYLOAD_INVALID: The details supplied are incomplete or invalid. Nothing was changed.
inputs.ITEM_EXISTS: That Item ID already exists. Use 'Add stocking location' to stock it somewhere else. Nothing was changed.
inputs.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: That Item ID does not exist. Nothing was changed.
inputs.STOCK_EXISTS: That item is already stocked at that location. Nothing was changed.
inputs.LOCATION_UNKNOWN: That location is not in the location list (an admin adds locations). Nothing was changed.
inputs.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The request being approved was not found.
inputs.TARGET_NOT_WAITING: That request is not waiting for approval.
inputs.NONZERO_STOCK: An item/location with stock cannot be deactivated. Count it to zero first. Nothing was changed.
inputs.GAVE_UP: This could not be processed after several automatic attempts. Nothing was changed. Please repeat it.
inputs.EXPIRED: No supervisor approved this in time. Nothing was changed. Please repeat it.
